rule_library: I write my exit condition down before I enter a trade.
I close a losing trade by the same written rule I use for a winning trade.
After a losing trade, I wait 15 minutes before I open the next one.
After two losing trades in a row, I stop trading for the day.
My size on the next trade does not change because of the last trade's result.
I trade only during the hours I set for myself in advance.
I review my trades at the end of the day, not while a trade is open.
